text: {"headline":"Provider 1000000429 bills 99215 well above risk-adjusted expectation, and the excess appears in every complexity tier, but records are too thin to tell upcoding from a complex panel.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"Most of this provider's 99215 claims fall on multi-morbid patients, such as C0214550 and C0214929, which fits a sicker panel. However, the by-complexity table shows their 99215 share running roughly two to three times the all-provider share within every condition tier, so the elevation persists after accounting for complexity rather than being explained by it. The small low-complexity slice, for example C0214517 (rash, no chronic conditions) and C0214692 and C0214908 (back pain only), is where billed intensity looks hardest to justify. Documentation cannot settle the question: only two 99215 charts came back, and both (C0215058, C0215094) supported the billed level. The two moderate-or-higher data-reviewed notes with no lab or test line on the claim are weak evidence at most. A reviewer should first request charts for the sampled low-complexity 99215 claims and a larger random set of 99214 and 99215 claims, since 99214 dominates the mix, to see whether the documented MDM holds up at volume."}
